# Sirach Chapter 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 16 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_016_page_001.jpg

---

**16:1** Don't wish for a large family of worthless children, and don't take pride in sons who don't fear God.

**16:2** Even if they're many, don't celebrate them — not unless the fear of the LORD is in them.

**16:3** Don't put your faith in their survival or take comfort in their numbers; one good person is worth more than a thousand, and it's better to die without children than to have ungodly ones.

**16:4** One person of understanding can repopulate a whole city; a clan of the lawless turns it into a wasteland.

**16:5** I have seen many things like this with my own eyes, and heard of even greater things.

**16:6** In a gathering of sinners, a fire breaks out; in a rebellious nation, God's anger ignites.

**16:7** He had no mercy for the ancient giants who rose up in their great strength.

**16:8** He did not spare Lot's neighbors, whom he detested for their arrogance.

**16:9** He showed no pity to the people marked for destruction — they were driven out because of their sins.

**16:10** The same went for the six hundred thousand foot soldiers who had hardened their hearts. Even if there had been only one stubborn person among them, it would have been remarkable if they got away with it.

**16:11** Both mercy and wrath belong to him; he has the power to forgive and the power to judge.

**16:12** He is as great in correction as in mercy; he judges each person by what they have done.

**16:13** A sinner won't get to keep what they've taken, and the patient endurance of the faithful won't be in vain.

**16:14** Every act of mercy finds its place; each person receives what their deeds deserve.

**16:15** He hardened Pharaoh so that Pharaoh would not acknowledge him, so that all the world would come to know what God can do.

**16:16** His mercy is visible throughout all creation; he has divided light and darkness for the human race.

**16:17** Don't say, "I'm too small for God to notice," or "Who up in heaven is going to think about me? With so many people around, I'm nothing — just one tiny soul in a vast creation."

**16:18** Look — the heavens and the highest heavens, the deep and the earth, all of them shake at his approach;

**16:19** the mountains and the foundations of the earth tremble and quake when God turns his gaze upon them.

**16:20** And yet no one stops to think about these things — who actually reflects on God's ways?

**16:21** Like a storm that comes and goes unseen, most of what God does remains hidden.

**16:22** Who can even announce all his righteous deeds? Who would wait long enough to see them? The appointed time seems so far away.

**16:23** People of limited understanding try to think it through — the foolish and misguided come up with foolish conclusions.

**16:24** Listen to me, my child — learn and let my words take root in your heart.

**16:25** I will measure out my teaching carefully and share knowledge with precision.

**16:26** When God created his works at the beginning, and as he was making them, he determined the portion of each.

**16:27** He established all things in an eternal order, dominion upon dominion through every generation. They never hunger, they never tire, they never stop their work.

**16:28** None of them crowds out another; they will never disobey his word.

**16:29** After all this, God looked down at the earth and filled it with his good gifts.

**16:30** He covered its surface with every kind of living creature — and to the earth they shall return.
